verdict.rationale: Claude Code's first-party docs say it can run Claude on a recurring schedule, with examples such as morning PR reviews, overnight CI analysis and weekly dependency audits. They also list "schedule recurring tasks" as a desktop capability. This is a true recurring schedule, not a one-off background task, but it is shown only at overview level. missing for 10: in-depth configuration docs (cadence syntax, triggers, limits, where scheduled runs execute), independent or hands-on corroboration that scheduled runs work as described

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: Run Claude on a schedule to automate work that repeats: morning PR reviews, overnight CI failure analysis, weekly dependency audits, or syncing docs after PRs merge.
schedule recurring tasks, and kick off cloud sessions
